messages:
maria: Quick heads-up, Acme reported their month-close invoice lists ~1,179,432 tokens but their dashboard shows 0 usage for Mar 31 - Apr 1. They're in a contract tier that should've been billed at standard rate. 

alex: Oof, thanks. Any chance this is a dashboard rendering cache issue or a metering gap? 

maria: Customer says invoices are final on their end; they attached a PDF. They see line item: 'API usage - tokens' with the total. Dashboard chart is flat. No recent plan change on their account. 

sachin: Pulling metering logs now. Do we have the account id? 

maria: acct_acme_42 — sent via DM. 

billing-bot: alert: billing-service produced checkpoint for acct_acme_42 at job 2022-03-31T23:59:58Z (run id: run-8f3a). Totals emitted: tokens=1179432, tier=standard. 

tim: If billing-service emitted a checkpoint and UI is flat, likely a dashboard ingestion or aggregation window mismatch. Could also be a shard-level lag in the analytics pipeline. 

julie: I looked at dashboard ingestion logs for that account: there was an error in the ingestion-worker around 2022-03-31T23:58:00Z — 504 from metrics-db. It retried but dropped the batch after 3 attempts (worker log excerpt below). 

julie: ```
2022-03-31T23:58:00Z ingestion-worker[pid=231]: WARN fetch batch acct_acme_42 seq=98765 -> 504 Gateway Time-out
2022-03-31T23:58:03Z ingestion-worker: retry attempt 1
2022-03-31T23:58:08Z ingestion-worker: retry attempt 2
2022-03-31T23:58:13Z ingestion-worker: max retries reached, dropping batch seq=98765
```

alex: That would cause the dashboard to miss a chunk but billing-service checkpoint still counted it if metering wrote to ledger earlier. We need to confirm ordering between metering->ledger checkpoint vs ingestion. 

engops: I can re-run the ingestion replay for seq range 98760-98770. Would that repopulate the dashboard? If ledger has tokens then yes. Note: replay is idempotent but will overwrite aggregates for that window. 

maria: Customer is asking for reconciliation steps and whether we can credit if it was our fault. Let's try to reproduce first. Sachin, can you fetch raw meter rows for acct_acme_42 for the window 2022-03-31T23:50 - 2022-04-01T00:05? 

sachin: Running query now. SQL I used: 
```
SELECT ts, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, route FROM metering.raw_events
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_42' AND ts >= '2022-03-31T23:50:00Z' AND ts <= '2022-04-01T00:05:00Z'
ORDER BY ts ASC;
```

sachin: Result sample (first 3 rows): 
```
2022-03-31T23:55:12Z | req_89a | gpt-4-alt | 1024 | 30 | api
2022-03-31T23:56:01Z | req_89b | gpt-4-alt | 2048 | 45 | api
2022-03-31T23:57:40Z | req_89c | gpt-4-alt | 4096 | 90 | api
```

sachin: Ledger state shows checkpoint run-8f3a committed tokens=1179432 at 2022-03-31T23:59:58Z. So metering and ledger agree. Ingestion dropped the batch -> dashboard missing. 

tim: Ok so root cause is dashboard ingestion-worker drop. Two remediation paths: 1) replay ingestion for those seqs so dashboard shows correct numbers; 2) issue a one-off dashboard patch and notify customer. Replay is preferable. 

engops: I'll kick off replay for seq 98760-98770 now. Replay command: `./replay_ingestion --account acct_acme_42 --start-seq 98760 --end-seq 98770 --idempotent` 

engops: Started replay job replay-20220331-1, estimated 2m. Will update when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

julie: Also created an alert ticket to investigate why ingestion-worker dropped instead of queueing to DLQ. Might be a bug in the retry/backoff logic when metrics-db returns 504 during cutoff windows. 

maria: Thanks. Customer asked whether invoice will change — we should not change invoices; if we confirm backend undercount vs invoice overcount on their side we should explain. Here ledger already billed the tokens; dashboard was missing — so customer invoice is correct. We should explain timeline and offer a credit if we find we caused late visibility that impacted their billing decisions. 

engops: Replay finished, aggregates recomputed. I can confirm dashboard now shows ~1.18M tokens for Mar 31. 

maria: Sending update to Acme: dashboard now matches invoice, ledger and metering were always consistent. We apologize for visibility gap due to ingestion-worker batch drop; offering 1 month of free premium support as goodwill. Draft message attached. 

alex: Quick follow-up: file an internal postmortem and add stronger DLQ behavior for ingestion-worker in the near-term fix. I've opened ENG-3472. 

maria: Thanks all. Customer happy with the resolution but asked for a short write-up on what went wrong. I'll post summary in #customer-ops once we have a root cause doc. :white_check_mark:
